summary: Prevent duplicate shopping-list item adds through ranked fresh matching and safe reuse enrichment.
reason: Fresh AnyList matching now uses Unicode-normalized token bags for punctuation and word-order variants, conservative ingredient-head plus descriptor identity, exact UPC/package evidence, and metadata richness to select a deterministic canonical row. Generic ingredients do not infer shredded/sliced/block form from quantity alone; explicit item or recipe text is required before a specific form is reused. Existing rows are reused without duplicate creation; compatible quantities accumulate and blank notes/barcode/package fields may be enriched without overwriting populated metadata.
validated_outcome: The item add path reads the target list from fresh user data before creating, ranks canonical candidates, requires explicit form evidence before reusing a specific preparation form, reuses the best unchecked match, merges compatible quantities, and verifies scalar/package/metadata enrichment by fresh read-back. Recipe-to-list carries raw ingredient/note form context, aggregates equivalent ingredients, updates existing quantities/details when safe, and adds only net-new rows. Focused matcher, form, quantity, and items-add tests pass; no live AnyList writes were performed.
